en.title: Nouns without an article
en.summary: Many nouns are used without any article; this is called the zero article.

paragraphs: Sometimes a noun has no article. This is called the zero article. It is not a mistake: it is a regular part of the grammar. We use it mainly when we speak about things in general, and with certain names and fixed expressions.

Use no article with plural and uncountable nouns that speak in general, with most names of people and places, and with meals, languages, sports and academic subjects. Many fixed phrases also have no article, particularly after prepositions of place and means of transport.

blocks.html:
CaseExample
general pluralDogs bark.
uncountable, generalRice is cheap.
languageShe speaks Italian.
mealWe have lunch at one.
fixed phraseat school, by car, in bed

paragraphs: We say go to school, in hospital and at church when we mean the main purpose of the place. We add the article when we mean the building or something else: I went to the school to meet the teacher.
After by, we use no article: by bus, by train, by air. But with in or on the article returns: in the car, on the bus. This is a common difficulty for learners.

items: Wrong: **The life is beautiful.** (in general) Right: **Life is beautiful.**
Wrong: **I go to the school every day.** (as a student) Right: **I go to school every day.**
Wrong: **We travelled by the train.** Right: **We travelled by train.**

ro.title: Substantivele fără articol
ro.summary: În limba română, multe substantive se folosesc fără niciun articol în situații uzuale.

paragraphs: Uneori, un substantiv nu are niciun fel de articol. Această formă se numește substantiv nearticulat. O folosim adesea când vorbim despre lucruri în general.

Substantivul rămâne în forma sa simplă, ca în dicționar. Nu adăugăm terminații la sfârșitul cuvântului și nu punem niciun cuvânt ajutător în fața lui. Folosim des această formă după prepoziții simple precum „în” sau „pe”.

blocks.html:
SituațieExemplu
După prepoziții simpleMergem la **munte**.
Cantități sau lucruri în generalAvem nevoie de **pâine**.
Profesii după verbul „a fi”Elena este **medic**.
Nume de orașeTrenul ajunge în **București**.
